limitations: The sharp Hellinger result treats the standardized one-parameter beta-precision hypergeometric path. Plug-in location/scale, the full critical likelihood-ratio experiment, second-order Hellinger terms, and finite-sample errors are not derived. Originality remains best-of-knowledge against broader sparse-mixture and normal-scale-mixture theory.
record_title: Gaussian-boundary hypergeometric laws: sharp Hellinger rate and root-n noncontiguity
